'''Hychroma''' is a [[Water]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Ninjaguana]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Has shattered boundaries of existence and can summon millions of water blades at will to break any defense. Hychroma still shuns attention but no longer fears being ignored. After all, the truly powerful need no spotlight."

Hychroma is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.
